interpretation.endpoints: Overall Suez Canal connects Mediterranean Sea / Port Said harbor at north to Gulf of Suez / Red Sea at south.
interpretation.route_network_not_single_unique_centerli: Official SCA explicitly describes parallel Canal and bypasses. More than one physical navigation axis may be legitimate. A single traversal must be based on preserved mapping tags/topology and geographic coverage, not invented shortest path.
interpretation.great_bitter_lakes: Official New Suez Canal project text explicitly describes Great Bitter Lakes bypasses, supporting requirement to inspect preserved linear crossing there.
interpretation.northern_alternate: SCA historical development description documents bypass from 17km south of Port Said to Mediterranean east of Port Fouad. Main Port Said entrance and alternate east channel must be distinguished.
